worldcombat.skill.obstruct.summary: Raises a spiked barricade that fully blocks attacks by a total pool; a contact attack sharply lowers the attacker's Defence. Repeated use tends to fail.
worldcombat.skill.obstruct.description.0: The barricade lasts %1$s and holds %2$s points, lowering contact attackers by %3$s levels; higher Defence makes it thicker and longer.
worldcombat.skill.obstruct.description.2: Repeat-use failure rate %1$s; the barbed/reinforced trade-off is the %2$s setting.
worldcombat.skill.obstruct.use.0: Bait a melee foe onto the barricade
worldcombat.skill.obstruct.use.1: Soften a foe before your follow-up
worldcombat.skill.obstruct.use.2: Hold a narrow gap and force a detour
worldcombat.skill.obstruct.preference.ba: On (barbed): contact drop +1, but pool x0.75, duration x0.85, recover 6 ticks. Off (reinforced): pool x1.2, duration x1.15, no extra drop, recover 10 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.obstruct.preference.ai: Raise once a threat enters this range. Larger sets up earlier but may waste the cast; smaller saves PP but bets the foe will close in.
